headline: Six primary authorities and three second-order innovations shipped; exact independent staging is verified and the Genius List is exhausted.

items.title: Evidence-semantic season and return continuity
items.evidence: Aligned/contested phase gates plus monotonic per-franchise return boundaries.

items.title: Propagation and release truth firewall
items.evidence: Project authority contract, expiring release receipts, and deterministic deployable fingerprints.

items.title: Independent Cloudflare staging
items.evidence: Stable custom origin, exact candidate, 11/11 provenance, exact-zone DNS, and rollback authority.

items.title: Truthful General Manager advancement
items.evidence: Every independent score/playoff/title/tenure path rendered with exact values.

followUps.title: Production revision parity
followUps.evidence: Promote only after email, founder approval, and lifecycle authorities are independently green.

followUps.title: Studio propagation mechanization
followUps.evidence: Consume the signed Ark defect cargo in the Studio Ops owner repo.

honestyLedger.title: No retention claim
honestyLedger.evidence: No consented cohort exists; product semantics improved without asserting outcome lift.
